description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror a DataFrame into a ServiceNow table via the Table API. Search-then-write (ServiceNow has no native upsert) — GET by `key_field=<value>` → PATCH existing row or POST new row. In-run cache prevents double-post on eventual-consistency lag. Source can be an upstream Dagster asset OR inline SQL / CSV / literal rows.

inputs.description: Either an upstream Dagster asset (via `upstream_asset_key`) OR an inline source config (via `source:` — SQL against a resource, a CSV file path, or literal rows). Each row → one ServiceNow record (upserted by matching on `key_field`).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_errored). No downstream data — the write side effect lands in ServiceNow.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream Dagster asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source:`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Read the DataFrame inline at run time. Shapes: {kind: sql, resource_key/database_url_env_var, query}, {kind: csv, path, read_csv_kwargs}, {kind: inline, rows}. Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

table.label: ServiceNow Table
table.description: Target table name (e.g. incident, change_request, cmdb_ci_server).

key_field.label: Key Field
key_field.description: ServiceNow field used to match existing rows (must be present in fields_map values).

name: ServiceNow Record Upsert
